name: Update Person
description: Updates an existing person in Pipedrive. [See the documentation](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/Persons#updatePerson)

configurable_props.name: personId
configurable_props.label: Person ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the person to update

configurable_props.name: ownerId
configurable_props.label: Owner ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the user who will be marked as the owner of this person. When omitted, the authorized user ID will be used.

configurable_props.name: organizationId
configurable_props.label: Organization ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the organization this person will belong to

configurable_props.name: emails
configurable_props.label: Emails
configurable_props.description: Email addresses (one or more) associated with the person, presented in the same manner as received by GET request of a person. **Example: {"value":"email1@email.com", "primary":true, "label":"work"}**

configurable_props.name: phones
configurable_props.label: Phones
configurable_props.description: Phone numbers (one or more) associated with the person, presented in the same manner as received by GET request of a person. **Example: {"value":"12345", "primary":true, "label":"work"}**

configurable_props.name: visibleTo
configurable_props.label: Visible To
configurable_props.description: Visibility of the person. If omitted, visibility will be set to the default visibility setting of this item type for the authorized user.
